name: Zero-Shot Query Intent Classification via Prototype Vector Distance
description: Instead of training a BERT classifier, user query vectors are compared against pre-computed 'intent prototype vectors' (e.g. Navigational, Transactional, Informational). The closest prototype labels the query intent.
prompt:
Instead of training a BERT classifier, user query vectors are compared against pre-computed 'intent prototype vectors' (e.g. Navigational, Transactional, Informational). The closest prototype labels the query intent.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: query_id, query_text, predicted_intent, confidence.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Classify each query to its closest intent prototype
            WITH ranked_intents AS (
                SELECT 
                    q.query_id,
                    q.query_text,
                    p.intent_name,
                    array_cosine_similarity(q.query_vector, p.prototype_vector) AS intent_similarity,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY q.query_id 
                        ORDER BY array_cosine_similarity(q.query_vector, p.prototype_vector) DESC
                    ) AS rank_match
                FROM inbound_queries q
                CROSS JOIN intent_prototypes p
            )
            SELECT 
                query_id,
                query_text,
                intent_name AS predicted_intent,
                ROUND(intent_similarity, 4) AS confidence
            FROM ranked_intents
            WHERE rank_match = 1
            ORDER BY query_id;
why_it_fails: Maintaining external classifier microservices adds 50ms latency to query planning.
